program:
var FolderStr:string := Folder4Objects -- generated from modelFile (autoexec)
if NOT existsFile(FolderStr) 
	str := modelFile
	FolderStr := strCopy(str,1,StrRpos("\\",str))
	Folder4Objects := FolderStr
end

if setCurrentDirectory(FolderStr) 
	print "The current Example Collection is: ",FolderStr
else
	print "Unknown folder '",FolderStr,"'"
	return
end

if .Models.numNodes > 2
	messageBox(to_str("It is only allowed",strChr(10),"to save a single object."), 1, 1)
	return
end

var GeneralTab:table := ~.SelDlg.GeneralTable

for var j := 1 to .Models.numNodes 
	var FrameObj:object := .Models.node(j)
	if FrameObj.name /= "internal" 
		var str:string := FrameObj.name
		
		for var cat := 1 to GeneralTab.yDim
			var catTab:table := GeneralTab[1,cat]
			catTab.setCursor(2,1)
			if catTab.find({2,1}..{2,*},str)
				str := catTab[2,catTab.cursorY]
			end
		next
	
		str := to_str(str,".obj")
		--closeDialog
		if FrameObj.writeObject(str,false)  -- no library
			print "Save ",str
			return
		end
	end
next
print "No example was loaded."
